AWPTCM-T33234.objective:
• A copper port defaults to automatic MDI/MDI-X polarity handling.
  • Under automatic polarity handling, a link establishes with a compliant partner over a copper straight-through cable and over a copper crossover cable.
  • When one or both sides are forced to a fixed MDI or MDIX polarity, the link establishes in compatible combinations and fails predictably — no link is established (or it is correctly reported as down) — in incompatible ones, without the port entering an unstable or inconsistent state.
  • The port accurately reports the resolved polarity (MDI or MDIX).
  • Link status is correctly reported as up once automatic polarity resolution completes.
  • After the cable is swapped between straight-through and crossover, the port re-resolves polarity cleanly, without retaining stale resolved state.
  • Automatic MDI/MDI-X handling resolves polarity correctly on a copper (1000BASE-T) SFP module, establishing a link over both straight-through and crossover copper cables.
  • Automatic MDI/MDI-X handling produces a working link across the supported copper cable and port types with a compliant partner.

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability.

Confirm a copper port defaults to automatic MDI/MDI-X polarity handling. With a compliant partner, confirm the link establishes over a copper straight-through cable and again over a copper crossover cable, with polarity resolved correctly in each case.

Force one or both sides to a fixed MDI or MDIX polarity across the supported combinations. Confirm the link establishes in compatible combinations and fails predictably — the link does not come up (or is correctly reported as down) — in incompatible ones, with the port remaining in a stable, consistent state.
Confirm the port accurately reports the resolved polarity (MDI or MDIX) and that link status is correctly reported as up once automatic polarity resolution completes.

On an established link, swap the cable between straight-through and crossover and confirm the port re-resolves polarity cleanly, with reported polarity and link status reflecting the new outcome and no stale state retained.

Repeat the automatic polarity check on a copper (1000BASE-T) SFP module: confirm the link establishes over both a copper straight-through cable and a copper crossover cable, with polarity resolved and reported correctly in each case.
